summary: Frontend-only smoke + interaction + responsive testing of the Product Breaker brutalist landing page. All sections render in order, all referenced data-testids are present, no console errors, no horizontal overflow at 1920px or 390px, FAQ accordion behavior is correct, anchor nav scrolls to the right sections, and every CTA button is present and enabled. Mobile menu toggle opens/closes correctly. No bugs found.

design_issues.screen: Section H2 headings (Dossier 'EVERY CHART EARNS ITS PLACE', Pricing 'FAIR. BLUNT. CHEAPER THAN A CONSULTANT.', FAQ 'THE PANEL DEBATES ITSELF, TOO.')
issues: Yellow/blue accent block sits on top of the heading text with a hard offset, producing a slight 'duplicate text peeking out from behind' effect. This appears intentional (brutalist offset-shadow aesthetic, same pattern used in hero 'SURVIVES' over red block) and is consistent across sections — not flagged as a bug, but worth a visual confirmation by the designer that the offset distance feels right (it currently cuts the top stroke of letters like 'F', 'E', 'B' below the colored block).

critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.jsx generates testids from label via toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-'). Works today (nav-the-chamber, nav-the-dossier, nav-how-it-works, nav-pricing, nav-faq) but is brittle — any future label rename will silently break the contract with downstream tests. Consider explicit testid mapping in the LINKS array.
App.js uses BrowserRouter + Routes for a single-route static page. Fine, but unnecessary overhead; could simplify to a plain component until a 2nd route is added.
All landing components live under one /components/landing folder which is good and well-scoped. No file exceeds the 700-line guideline (largest is Hero/Dossier within reasonable bounds).

FAQ defaults to open={0} (first item expanded on mount). UX-wise this is fine, but it means clicking faq-trigger-0 first will collapse rather than expand — automated tests should be aware of this initial state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static landing page at /. All sections share data-testid attributes per spec. Verified at 1920x1080 and 390x844. FAQ has initial open=0; toggling same trigger closes it. Anchor nav targets are section ids: how-it-works, chamber, dossier, pricing, faq. No backend, no API calls.
verified_flows: Page loads in correct section order: navbar -> hero -> marquee -> how-it-works -> chamber (Agents) -> dossier -> process -> pricing -> faq -> final-cta -> footer

All data-testids present: landing-page, navbar, logo, mobile-menu-toggle, nav-how-it-works, nav-the-chamber, nav-the-dossier, nav-pricing, nav-faq, hero-primary-cta, hero-secondary-cta, terminal-input-mock, terminal-run-button, agent-card-1..5, agents-cta, dossier-bento-grid, dossier-sample-cta, dossier-generate-cta, pricing-card-starter/builder/founder, pricing-cta-starter/builder/founder, faq-section, faq-trigger-0..5, faq-accordion-item-0..5, final-cta-button
No console errors or pageerrors (0 captured)
No horizontal overflow at desktop (1920) or mobile (390)
FAQ accordion: initial state opens item 0; clicking faq-trigger-2 closes 0 + opens 2; clicking faq-trigger-2 again closes 2 (none open). +/- icon swaps via Plus/Minus from lucide.
Anchor nav: all 5 nav links scroll their target section into view
Mobile menu toggle (390px): opens vertical link list and closes on re-click
Mobile layout: pricing cards stack (top values 7424, 7901, 8438; consistent x=24, width=342), dossier renders in 2-col grid which still fits viewport
